audience: businesses that send text messages with Voodoo SMS

useCases.title: Check how many SMS credits are left
useCases.text: The AI reads the credit balance of the account. One credit pays for one SMS part.

useCases.title: Check if sent texts were delivered
useCases.text: The AI lists delivery reports with recipient, sent and delivered time, price and status, optionally filtered by date.

useCases.title: Read the replies that came into your inbox
useCases.text: The AI lists SMS received on your virtual mobile numbers, such as replies and keyword messages, and shows your numbers.

useCases.title: Send an SMS or cancel a scheduled one
useCases.text: The AI sends one SMS to one recipient, which uses credits, or validates and prices it first in sandbox mode. It can list and cancel scheduled messages.

useCases.title: Check or add numbers on the opt-out blacklist
useCases.text: The AI lists the blacklisted numbers or looks up one number, and adds a number of someone who asked to stop. It cannot remove a number again.

useCases.title: Create or update contact lists
useCases.text: The AI lists contact lists and their contacts, creates a list, renames a list or adds contacts to it. It sends nothing.
